kind: Supplementary descriptive engine observations; no quality pass or human-play claim.

method.relationshipToPrimaryAudit: Requested after the primary metric freeze. These slices are additional diagnostics; no primary metric or acceptance threshold was changed.
method.days: Advance one day at a time through day 300. Event windows include both endpoints.
method.foodShortage: At least one settlement with organic population >0 and food <=0 after that day’s update. Synthetic-only or collective-only occupancy does not count.
method.foodDuration: World-days, not settlement-days. A continuous world streak can involve different settlements.
method.exclusions: Non-birth household outcomes exclude synthetic replication, collective expansion, surveys, pressure/recovery notices, births and power redistribution. Their full counts remain visible; excluding them is not a claim that they have no physical effects.
